title: Nexus CharacterSoulNarrativeRequest
description: Request body for POST /v1/daemon/characters/{character_id}/soul/reflect. Reads or regenerates the cached whole-Character SOUL narrative. `binding_id` scopes stats/cache to one active binding-local World life; omitted uses the shared Character scope. Synthesis is explicit/on-demand: it runs only when `force_regenerate` is true and the insufficient-data gate passes.
